form.label: Meraki VPN Firewall Rule Hits
form.description: Organization site-to-site VPN firewall rules (Dashboard API) with hit counts (MX syslog, vpn_firewall).

search.query: | inputlookup meraki_vpnfw_rules | stats count by org_id org_name | eval label=org_name." (".org_id.")"

| inputlookup meraki_vpnfw_rules where org_id="$org$" | eval row="rule", shadowed_by=coalesce(shadowed_by, "") | append [ search `$hits_src$` | search org_id="$org$" | stats sum(hits) AS hits max(last_hit) AS last_hit by signature | eval row="hits" ] | eventstats sum(hits) AS sig_hits max(last_hit) AS sig_last by signature | where row=="rule" | eval rule_hits=if(shadowed_by=="", coalesce(sig_hits, 0), 0) | eval note=case(shadowed_by!="", "Never matched: shadowed by rule #".shadowed_by, syslogEnabled!="true" AND rule_hits==0, "Syslog off: hits not counted", rule_hits==0, "No hits in range", true(), "") | eval rule_hits=if(syslogEnabled!="true" AND rule_hits==0, null(), rule_hits) | eventstats sum(rule_hits) AS total | eval "% of hits"=if(total>0 AND isnotnull(rule_hits), round(100*rule_hits/total, 2), null()) | eval "#"=if(is_default=="true", "default", rule_index), "Last hit"=if(isnotnull(sig_last) AND shadowed_by=="", strftime(sig_last, "%F %T"), "") | eval Syslog=if(syslogEnabled=="true", "on", "off") | sort 0 rule_index | rename policy AS Policy comment AS "Rule description" protocol AS Protocol srcCidr AS Source srcPort AS "Src port" destCidr AS Destination destPort AS "Dst port" rule_hits AS Hits note AS Note | table "#" Policy "Rule description" Protocol Source "Src port" Destination "Dst port" Syslog Hits "% of hits" "Last hit" Note signature
where Syslog=="on" AND Hits==0 | stats count
search org_id="$org$" OR org_id="unknown" | lookup meraki_vpnfw_rules org_id signature OUTPUT rule_index | where isnull(rule_index) | stats sum(hits) AS hits | fillnull value=0 hits

panel.title: Rules and hits (yellow = zero hits; click a rule to open its logs)

table.fields: ["#","Policy","Rule description","Protocol","Source","Src port","Destination","Dst port","Syslog","Hits","% of hits","Last hit","Note"]

panel.title: Hits per MX for rule “$sel_rule$” (click a row to close)

search.query: `$hits_src$` | search org_id="$org$" | where signature==$sel_sig|s$ | stats sum(hits) AS Hits max(last_hit) AS last by mx_name mx_mac | eval "Last hit"=strftime(last, "%F %T") | rename mx_name AS MX mx_mac AS MAC | table MX MAC Hits "Last hit" | sort - Hits

panel.title: Unmatched syslog patterns (rule changed, MX not in a polled org, or unsupported rule syntax)

search.query: search org_id="$org$" OR org_id="unknown" | lookup meraki_vpnfw_rules org_id signature OUTPUT rule_index | where isnull(rule_index) | stats sum(hits) AS Hits max(last_hit) AS last by org_id mx_name fw_pattern | eval "Last hit"=strftime(last, "%F %T") | rename org_id AS Org mx_name AS MX fw_pattern AS "Syslog pattern" | table Org MX "Syslog pattern" Hits "Last hit" | sort - Hits
